notes.title: Rune Bender VR released on Steam!
notes.content:
Nurogames released “Rune Bender VR” on Steam today. The action-packed roguelike game is set in Slavic mythology.

In Rune Bender VR the player fights in the guise of a mystical shaman, alongside the good god Veles and defends his sanctuary with magic runes against the onrushing horde waves of the mad god Perun. The game was funded by the German Federal Ministry of Economics and Climate Protection (BMWK).

notes.title: New screenshots of the upcoming “Rune Bender VR” release
notes.content: The countdown is on. At the end of next week, on September 20, 2024, “Rune Bender VR” will be released on Steam. The screenshots on the website and on Steam have been updated for the upcoming release.

notes.title: Trailer for “Rune Bender VR” released!
notes.content:
Nurogames today released the official trailer for the game Rune Bender VR, which will be released for virtual reality in summer / fall 2024. 

In addition, the game can already be saved on Steam as a title in the wishlist!


Rune Bender VR is an action-packed roguelike game from Nurogames, borrowed from Slavic mythology. In the guise of a mystical shaman, the player fights alongside the good god Veles and defends his sanctuary with magic runes against the onrushing horde waves of the mad god Perun. The game was funded by the German Federal Ministry of Economics and Climate Protection (BMWK).


The trailer is the current state of the development and will change frequently until the final release.

notes.title: New impressions of “Rune Bender VR”
notes.content: Nurogames today published new screenshots for the game “Rune Bender VR”, which will be released for virtual reality in 2024.
